integrity: The proof is mathematical and the finite checker is only corroborative. The closest existing bipartite special case is acknowledged; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a finite nonempty simple graph with clique number equal to chromatic number. No characterization outside that class, no converse, no graph-representation minimality or independent priority verification is asserted.
title: Remanent run-avoidance collapse and exact automaton size when \(\chi(G)=\omega(G)\)
